test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is '**adequate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**adequate**'. • It means** 'enough for what you need'.** (आवश्‍यकता के अनुसार पर्याप्त) • *Example: Make sure you take an **adequate** supply of water with you.* **Correct Sentence:__** *"We did carry **adequate** warm clothing..."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Acceptable**: that can be allowed. (जिसे माना जा सके; स्‍वीकार्य) • **Capable**: having the ability or qualities necessary to do something. (कुछ करने में सक्षम या समर्थ) • **Satisfactory**: good enough for a particular purpose; acceptable. (संतोषजनक (उद्देश्‍य विशेष के लिए पर्याप्त); स्‍वीकार्य) 45:Ta11, The correct answer is '**forgot**'.
